ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for Gies College of Business students that are studying abroad only until Monday, November 29, 2021. At approximately 10:00a.m. on that date, this section will open to all of campus with an enrollment limit to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this required course. Gies College of Business students are required to register for the in-class option of this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s).
